title.narrative: STRENGTHENING COMMUNITY PARTNERSHIPS AND ORGANIZATIONAL CAPACITY TO INCREASE SITE PROTECTION FOR BORNEAN ELEPHANTS IN THE DERAMAKOT LANDSCAPE, MALAYSIA

description.narrative: THE DERAMAKOT LANDSCAPE IN SABAH, MALAYSIAN BORNEO MAKES UP PART OF THE CENTRAL SABAH MANAGED ELEPHANT RANGE. IN THIS KEY LANDSCAPE FOR BORNEAN ELEPHANTS, PANTHERA HAS BEEN WORKING CLOSELY WITH GOVERNMENT AGENCIES AND LOCAL COMMUNITIES FOR THE LAST THREE YEARS. WE HAVE SUPPORTED A PARTNERSHIP BETWEEN GOVERNMENT AGENCIES AND FOUR LOCAL COMMUNITIES TO INSTITUTIONALIZE COMMUNITY RANGER TEAMS AND COMMUNITY-BASED PATROLLING. MOVING FORWARD, WE PROPOSE TO INCREASE SITE PROTECTION IN DERAMAKOT BY SUPPORTING COMMUNITIES IN THE CREATION OF A COMMUNITY CONSERVATION AREA (CCA) IN AN AREA OF CURRENTLY UNPROTECTED FORESTS. THE LONG-TERM GOAL FOR THIS CCA IS THAT IT WILL BE MANAGED BY LOCAL COMMUNITIES FOR THEIR CULTURAL NEEDS (SUSTAINABLE HARVEST OF BEARDED PIGS AND SAMBAR FOR WILD MEAT). THE CCA WILL ALSO SERVE TO CLOSE A KEY GAP IN DERAMAKOTS OVERALL SITE PROTECTION, WHERE POACHERS FROM OUTSIDE KERAMUAK USE THE UNPROTECTED FORESTS TO ENTER THE LANDSCAPE. IN ADDITION TO THE CCA, WE PROPOSE TO INCREASE CAPACITY FOR DERAMAKOT ENFORCEMENT TEAM LEADERS IN TERMS OF EVIDENCE-BASED PATROL PLANNING. THIS WILL ENSURE THAT COMMUNITY RANGER TEAMS ARE PROPERLY UTILIZED TO PATROL POACHING HOTSPOTS. LASTLY, WE WILL WORK WITH DIFFERENT GOVERNMENT AGENCIES IN DERAMAKOT TO OVERCOME INTER-AGENCY DATA SHARING CHALLENGES USING A ONE-STOP CLOUD
